message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of successive self-improving agents, with benchmarked versions feeding into later meta-improvement steps.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram shows three pale-gray rounded panels labeled Agent 0, Agent 1, and Agent 2, followed by an ellipsis indicating continuation. Each panel contains a code bar (Base Code in Agent 0; Agent 1 Code and Agent 2 Code in the next panels), a Benchmarks bar, and three darker bars labeled Bench 1, Bench 2, and Bench 3. Thin vertical rules sit beside the benchmark lists. Blue right-pointing arrows labeled vertically “Meta-Improvement” lead from the selection below Agent 0 to Agent 1, from the selection below Agents 0 and 1 to Agent 2, and from the selection below Agents 0 through 2 toward the ellipsis. Beneath the panels, black bracket-like lines group Agent 0 alone under “Base Agent,” Agents 0 and 1 under “Best Agent 0, 1,” and Agents 0 through 2 under “Best Agent 0, ..., 2.” The arrows indicate that the selected base or best agent is used for the next meta-improvement step; the process continues beyond Agent 2.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
